mapper.select:
select d.data_id, d.contract, d.gym_id, d.sender_id, d.receiver_id, d.receiver_name, d.receiver_phone, d.status, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.amount, d.amount_type, d.rate_percent, d.billing_cycle, d.title, d.quantity, d.unit_price, d.valid_months, d.note, d.issue_date, d.signed_at, c.contract_type, c.contract_name, m.username as m_username, m.name as m_name, m.email as m_email, m.role as m_role, m.gym_id as m_gym_id, m.contract as m_contract from "h_contract_data" d join "h_contract" c on d.contract = c.contract_id left join "h_member" m on d.receiver_id = m.username
and c.contract_type = 'ADMIN_OWNER'
and d.sender_id = #{username} and c.contract_type in ('OWNER_TRAINER', 'OWNER_MEMBER_MEMBERSHIP', 'OWNER_MEMBER_PT')
and c.contract_type = 'OWNER_MEMBER_PT' and d.gym_id = (select gym_id from "h_member" where username = #{username})
and 1 = 0
and c.contract_type = #{contractType}
order by d.issue_date desc, d.data_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into "h_contract_data" (contract, gym_id, sender_id, receiver_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, status, start_date, end_date, amount, amount_type, rate_percent, billing_cycle, title, quantity, unit_price, valid_months, note, issue_date) values ((select contract_id from "h_contract" where contract_type = #{contractType}), #{gymId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}::date, #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}::date, #{amount, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{amountType}, #{ratePercent, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{billingCycle, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{quantity, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{unitPrice, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{validMonths, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, current_date)
